profile_text.body:
The AI Now Institute is a nonprofit founded in 2017 and headquartered in New York, NY, according to its About page. On its website the organization says it challenges and reimagines the current trajectory for AI. Its site highlights commentary from its staff on AI policy and industry conduct.

The site names several people affiliated with the institute. Co-Executive Director Sarah Myers West appeared on the Washington Journal to discuss how artificial intelligence should be regulated. Senior Research Scientist Boyan Milanov argues that AI doomerism is not based on scientific work and that calls for regulation from within the industry are attempts by AI companies to set their own standards. Aya Ibrahim warned against one-size-fits-all security steps after NVIDIA announced a new agent safety platform. Heidy Khlaaf said that acknowledging harms of AI technology would not be profitable for AI companies, which the site says continue promoting their products as instrumental in national infrastructure.

The institute is recorded as operating in New York, where 459 cases are tracked. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are listed for it.
